name: @ecopages/radiant-monorepo
description: A minimalist web component library designed for simplicity and flexibility

scripts.clean: clear && bunx npkill -D -y && rm -rf bun.lock && bun install
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/jsx/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/signals/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/radiant/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p playground/vite/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p playground/vite-nitro/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/docs/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:all: bun run --elide-lines=0 --filter @ecopages/jsx build:lib && bun run --elide-lines=0 --filter @ecopages/signals build:lib && bun run --elide-lines=0 --filter @ecopages/radiant build:lib
scripts.test:all: bun run --elide-lines=0 --filter @ecopages/jsx test:lib && bun run --elide-lines=0 --filter @ecopages/signals test:lib && bun run --elide-lines=0 --filter @ecopages/radiant test:lib && bun run --elide-lines=0 --filter radiant-docs test:e2e && bun run --elide-lines=0 --filter playground-vite-nitro test:e2e && bun run --elide-lines=0 --filter playground-vite test:e2e && bun run size:check
scripts.prerelease: bun run build:all && bun run test:all
scripts.dev:playground-vite: bun run --elide-lines=0 --filter playground-vite dev & bun run watch:lib
scripts.dev:playground-vite-nitro: bun run --elide-lines=0 --filter playground-vite-nitro dev & bun run watch:lib
scripts.dev:playground-vite:legacy: bun run --elide-lines=0 --filter playground-vite dev:legacy & bun run watch:lib
